confidence_notes: Restaurant meal and hostel dorm anchors rest on cost-of-living and listing-site aggregates, though those sources mix currencies and have unclear dates. The 3-star hotel anchor is a converted Trip.com average that may not be specific to double rooms. The private hostel, 1-star hotel, beer, coffee, cocktail and wine anchors are bounded judgment estimates from general knowledge of Lima prices. Cocktail and wine were set using a local price relationship to beer (cocktail about twice a beer, wine glass about twice a beer), since no direct Lima bar or restaurant price was found. The FX observation came from a search summary of the RBA exchange rates page, not from a directly opened page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors are Lima-specific, drawn from MyLifeElsewhere and Expatistan restaurant and beer prices, Hostelz average dorm prices, and Trip.com 3-star averages. Private hostel, 1-star hotel, cocktail and wine anchors are judgment-based.
